description: A representation of a gwent card

rfid.description: The RFID tag ID that this card has been written to. Can be used to prevent accidental overwriting

owner.description: The player that owns this card

owner_nickname.description: Short nickname for the owner, displayed in the TUI

pronoun.description: Subject pronoun for the character (he/she/it). Used for in-game narration.

image.description: Relative file path or URL for the card's photo image

card_text.description: Flavour or ability text printed on the physical card

image_verified.description: Whether the image field has been verified as the correct match for this specific card. false if a best-guess match was used (e.g. suffixed card using base image)

ranges.description: Determines which row(s) the card applies to. Cards with agile ability can have more than one range and are placed in a row upon playing. The row chosen cannot change after placing.

strength.description: How many points this character carries

starter.description: Whether this card is a member the starter deck

instructions.description: Instructions to be shown on screen when this leader is played

reshuffle_graveyards.description: Indicates that the leader requires all discard cards to be shuffled back into the deck

draw_opponent_discard.description: Indicates that the leader allows the player to draw from their opponents discard pile

weather_ranges.description: Enables the leader to play a weather card of any of specified ranges from the deck

commander_ranges.description: Enables the leader to act as a commander for any of the specified ranges

game_id.description: Unique identifier for the current game session

specialty.description: Determines if a special ability is applied from this card. If the specialty is weather the range determines if it's frost, fog or rain. The scorch specialty applies to the entire board (which is also indicated by it having all ranges), as opposed to the scorch ability which applies only to the opponent's row of the same single range. Similarly the commander specialty means the card can be applied to any single row (indicated by the ranges it posseses) as opposed to the commander ability which only applies to a single row

transforms_to.description: Name of the card that a berserker transforms to

abilities.description: Describes the abilities that this card posseses

musters_with.description: List of card names that this card musters with when played. Empty array means standalone muster (no companions). Numbered suffixes (: 1, : 2) muster together; alpha suffixes (Crone: Brewess/Weavess/Whispess) muster together.

last_updated.description: ISO timestamp of when this card's data was last modified

rfid_written_at.description: ISO timestamp of when this card's RFID chip was last programmed. Stale if last_updated > rfid_written_at
